    StartersSpecs and Tucker's spiced snack mixCorn chips, pretzels and cheese crackers baked in smoked paprika butterHow to make it100g corn chips100g pretzels100g cheese crackers50g butter, melted1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp garlic powderToss the corn chips, pretzels and crackers with the butter, paprika and garlic powder.Bake at 150°C for 20 minutes.Tip into paper bags labelled like evidence.The Further fog dipCharred eggplant blended with tahini, garlic and lemon, with warm flatbreadHow to make it2 eggplants3 tbsp tahini1 garlic clove1 lemon, juiced1 tsp smoked paprika4 flatbreadsChar the eggplants whole over a gas flame until collapsed.Scoop out the flesh and blend with tahini, garlic, lemon juice and paprika.Warm the flatbreads and serve with the dip.Séance night smoky devilled eggsElise in her gas mask at the séance in Dalton's roomHow to make itAs written, serves 4Creamy devilled eggs whipped with mayo, Dijon and a little pickle juice, piped high and topped with smoked paprika, crisp bacon crumbs and chives.Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve.Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp pickle juice, salt and pepper until smooth.Fry 3 rashers of bacon until very crisp and crumble.Pipe the yolk mix into the whites, dust with smoked paprika and top with the bacon and snipped chives.Tulip spinach and artichoke dip with pitaTiny Tim's on the record player.
